**Mobile app:** the `.apk` installs on Android (arm64), `ios-arm64-simulator.zip` runs in the iOS Simulator on Apple silicon, and the `.ipa`, when there is one, is signed for iPhone and iPad.

**Downloads:** https://volt.leularia.com/download

Mac builds are signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized. Volt 0.0.3 and older cannot update themselves: download this build once and replace the app.
